messages.text:
"3D Soulslike Dark Fantasy RPG

Create a playable 3D third-person action RPG inspired by Dark Souls 1.

Graphics and World:

- Simple but atmospheric 3D graphics.
- Dark medieval fantasy environments.
- Explore castles, forests, caves, dungeons, ruins and villages.
- Interconnected areas with hidden paths, shortcuts and treasures.
- NPCs, enemies, merchants and blacksmiths.

Player Mechanics:

- Third-person movement, running, jumping and rolling.
- Lock-on targeting system.
- Stamina-based combat.
- Light and heavy attacks.
- Shield blocking, timed parrying, ripostes and backstabs.
- Dodge rolls with temporary invulnerability.
- One-handed and two-handed weapon combat.

Combat and Equipment:

- Swords, greatswords, axes, hammers, spears, daggers and bows.
- Different shields with individual defensive statistics.
- Individual armor slots: helmet, chest armor, gloves and leggings.
- Allow mixing different armor pieces freely.
- Include complete armor sets, rings and equipment weight.
- Equipment weight affects movement and rolling speed.
- Weapon upgrades using materials and blacksmiths.

RPG Progression:

- Health, stamina and Souls.
- Defeating enemies and bosses rewards Souls.
- Spend Souls at Bonfires to manually level up.
- Increase Vitality, Endurance, Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence and Faith.
- Higher levels require progressively more Souls.
- Souls are lost upon death but can be recovered at the previous death location.

Bonfire System:

- Rest to restore health and healing flasks.
- Level up and replenish resources.
- Resting respawns ordinary enemies.
- Include Estus Flasks with limited healing charges.

Enemies and Bosses:

- Undead soldiers, knights, skeletons, monsters, demons and dragons.
- Enemies have different attack patterns and behaviors.
- Large bosses with unique attacks, health bars and challenging battles.
- Bosses reward Souls and special equipment.

Magic:

- Include sorcery, miracles and pyromancy.
- Spells consume limited uses.
- Magic requires appropriate catalysts or equipment.

Quests and Exploration:

- NPC dialogue and optional quests.
- Hidden weapons, armor, treasures and secret areas.
- Keys, locked doors, environmental puzzles and dungeon exploration.
- A mysterious dark fantasy storyline.

Essential Requirement:

The game must be fully playable, not just a visual demonstration. Implement functional movement, combat, enemies, health, stamina, equipment, inventory, bonfires, leveling with Souls, death and respawning, and at least one complete dungeon with a boss.

Prioritize working gameplay mechanics over graphics and world size. Create a small but complete playable Soulslike experience first

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
